Name: NPC Farmhands
Author: sodabroo
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
NPC Farmhands adds an in-game employment and contract system for players who want farm automation without replacing villagers with invisible background calculations. Hire an available NPC, agree on a wage and type of work, and watch the worker travel to the farm, move between real work targets, perform visible interactions, and return to their normal game location when the job is finished.
The mod is designed to make a developed farm feel active and lived-in. Workers can handle repetitive daily chores while the player focuses on planning, exploration, relationships, or other activities. Work is divided between specialized contracts so multiple hired NPCs can cooperate without intentionally repeating the same responsibilities.
Jobs cover crop care and collection, animal care, fish-pond management, machine production, and mining/combat support. Supported work areas expand with the player's game progress, so locked locations such as Ginger Island are ignored until they have actually been unlocked.
NPC Farmhands also prioritizes safe, visible behavior. Workers follow walkable routes whenever one exists, recalculate around temporary obstacles, do not destroy player-placed objects, and use a farm report-point teleport only for special NPCs whose original maps have no physically connected route into the normal world.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.[/*]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or later and launch the game through SMAPI at least once.[/*]
[*]Download the NPC Farmhands main file.[/*]
[*]Extract the archive. Move the resulting
[code]NpcFarmhands[/code]folder directly into the game's
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Check that the final structure is
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/NpcFarmhands/manifest.json[/code]. Do not leave the mod inside an extra nested folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]To update, extract the new version over the existing
[code]NpcFarmhands[/code]folder and allow matching files to be replaced. The download does not include
[code]config.json[/code], so extracting over the existing folder preserves your settings. If you prefer to delete the old folder first, back up
[code]config.json[/code]before doing so.
After loading a save:
[list]
[*]Press
[code]H(Interact with NPC)[/code]or
[code]L[/code]to open the employment center.[/*]
[*]Press
[code]J[/code]near a chest to bind crop/collection output.[/*]
[*]Press
[code]K[/code]near a chest to bind animal products.[/*]
[*]Press
[code]P[/code]near a chest to bind fish-pond output.[/*]
[*]Press
[code]N[/code]near a chest to bind mining loot.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, only the host can use the hiring feature. [/*]
[*]Contract wages can be changed or contracts cancelled through the management interface.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Employment center and contracts:[/b] View hireable NPCs, see recommended workers, assign specialized jobs, set wages, edit contracts, and cancel contracts through an in-game interface.[/*]
[*][b]Visible workers:[/b] NPCs physically travel, walk between individual targets, perform visible interactions, report their results, and return to their saved game locations.[/*]
[*][b]Crop care and collection:[/b] Waters and harvests crops and gathers supported forage, fruit-tree products, bushes, garden-pot crops, and other eligible non-animal collection targets.[/*]
[*][b]Animal care:[/b] Pets animals; collects milk, wool, eggs, and other products; manages supported animal-product machines; and refills empty feeding troughs when hay is available.[/*]
[*][b]Fish-pond management:[/b] Collects pond output and finished roe products, stores them in the bound chest, and fills empty preserves jars with the highest-value available roe first.[/*]
[*][b]Selectable machine production:[/b] Lets players choose products from a catalog, finds available ingredients, supports multi-ingredient recipes, collects completed products, and manages machines repeatedly throughout the day.[/*]
[*][b]Mining and combat companion:[/b] Follows the player between mine floors, mines with steel-pickaxe power, clears sword-breakable debris, collects nearby drops, and fights monsters using Obsidian Edge combat values.[/*]
[*][b]Separated responsibilities:[/b] Different worker types avoid intentionally performing another specialist's assigned work.[/*]
[*][b]Expanded work scope:[/b] Supports the main farm, farm buildings, greenhouse, farmhouse-related areas, unlocked Ginger Island farm areas, and other supported collection locations.[/*]
[*][b]Safer routing:[/b] Replans around temporary obstacles, protects player objects and trees, recovers from invalid map borders, and teleports special disconnected NPCs to the farm reporting point when necessary.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher is not required.[/*]
[*]Use a desktop version of Stardew Valley supported by SMAPI. This release was built and tested on Windows.[/*]
[*]Single-player and host-controlled play have received the most testing. In multiplayer, install the mod for the host and treat the host's world state as authoritative.[/*]
[*]Ordinary chests are only needed when binding output storage; they are game items, not another mod dependency.[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout outs[/heading]
[list]
[*]ConcernedApe, for creating Stardew Valley and a world worth expanding.[/*]
[*]Pathoschild and all SMAPI contributors, for the framework, documentation, and tools that make code mods possible.[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley Modding Wiki maintainers and wider modding community, whose shared technical knowledge made this project possible.[/*]
[*]Everyone who tested long work sessions, reported routing and interaction problems, and helped turn repeated edge cases into a more reliable release.[/*]
[/list][b]描述[/b]
NPC Farmhands 为游戏添加了一套完整的雇佣与合同系统，让玩家在不使用“隐形后台计算”替代村民的前提下实现农场自动化。你可以雇佣空闲的 NPC，商定工资与工种，然后看着工人前往农场，在各个真实工作目标之间移动，执行可见的交互动作，并在工作结束后返回其原本的游戏位置。
本模组旨在让发展中的农场显得更有活力、更有人气。工人可以处理重复的日常杂务，让玩家能专注于规划、探索、社交或其他活动。工作被划分为不同的专业合同，因此多名被雇佣的 NPC 可以协同工作，而不会故意重复相同的职责。
工作范围涵盖作物照料与收获、动物照顾、鱼塘管理、机器生产，以及采矿/战斗辅助。支持的工作区域会随玩家游戏进度扩展，因此诸如姜岛等未解锁的地点会在实际解锁之前被忽略。
NPC Farmhands 同样优先保证行为的安全性与可视性。工人会尽可能沿可通行的路径行走，遇到临时障碍物时会重新规划路线，不会破坏玩家放置的物体，并且仅对原本地图没有物理连接路径进入正常世界的特殊 NPC，才会使用农场报告点传送。
[line]
[b]安装说明[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 Stardew Valley 1.6.15 或更高版本。[/*]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本，并至少通过 SMAPI 启动游戏一次。[/*]
[*]下载 NPC Farmhands 主文件。[/*]
[*]解压压缩包，将得到的 
[code]NpcFarmhands[/code] 文件夹直接移动到游戏根目录下的 
[code]Mods[/code] 文件夹中。[/*]
[*]检查最终目录结构是否为 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/NpcFarmhands/manifest.json[/code]。请勿将模组放在额外的嵌套文件夹内。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list][b]更新方法[/b]：将新版本解压到已有的 
[code]NpcFarmhands[/code] 文件夹上，并允许覆盖同名文件。下载包中不包含 
[code]config.json[/code]，因此覆盖安装会保留你的个人设置。如果你倾向于先删除旧文件夹，请记得提前备份 
[code]config.json[/code]。
[line]
[b]读档后的操作键位[/b]
[list]
[*]按 [b]H（与 NPC 交互）[/b] 或 [b]L[/b] 打开雇佣中心。[/*]
[*]在箱子旁按 [b]J[/b] 绑定作物/采集物输出箱。[/*]
[*]在箱子旁按 [b]K[/b] 绑定动物产品输出箱。[/*]
[*]在箱子旁按 [b]P[/b] 绑定鱼塘产出输出箱。[/*]
[*]在箱子旁按 [b]N[/b] 绑定采矿战利品输出箱。[/*]
[/list]在多人游戏中，只有主机玩家可以使用雇佣功能。合同工资可以调整，合同也可以通过管理界面取消。
[line]
[b]主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*][b]雇佣中心与合同[/b]：通过游戏内界面查看可雇佣的 NPC、查看推荐工人、分配专业工作、设定工资、编辑合同及取消合同。[/*]
[*][b]可视化工人[/b]：NPC 会实际移动，在单个目标之间行走，执行可见的交互动作，报告工作结果，并返回其存档时的原始位置。[/*]
[*][b]作物照料与采集[/b]：浇灌和收获作物，收集支持的采集物、果树产品、灌木浆果、花园盆作物及其他符合条件的非动物类采集目标。[/*]
[*][b]动物照顾[/b]：抚摸动物；收集牛奶、羊毛、蛋类及其他产品；管理支持的动物产品加工机；有干草时补充空的喂食槽。[/*]
[*][b]鱼塘管理[/b]：收集鱼塘产出及加工完成的鱼子酱/腌鱼籽产品，存入绑定箱子，并优先用最高价值的鱼籽填充空的腌渍罐。[/*]
[*][b]可选择的机器生产[/b]：玩家可从产品目录中选择生产项目，模组会自动寻找可用原料，支持多原料配方，收集已完成产品，并可在一天内多次管理机器。[/*]
[*][b]采矿与战斗伙伴[/b]：跟随玩家在矿洞层间移动，使用钢镐等级的挖矿能力，清除可用剑击碎的障碍物，收集附近的掉落物，并使用黑曜石之刃的战斗数值与怪物战斗。[/*]
[*][b]职责分离[/b]：不同工种的工人不会故意执行其他专业工人的分配任务。[/*]
[*][b]扩展的工作范围[/b]：支持主农场、农场建筑、温室、农舍相关区域、已解锁的姜岛农场区域，以及其他支持的采集地点。[/*]
[*][b]更安全的路径规划[/b]：能针对临时障碍物重新规划路线，保护玩家物体和树木，能从无效地图边界中恢复，并在必要时将特殊断连 NPC 传送到农场报告点。[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]需求[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 或更高版本。[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本。[/*]
[*]不需要 Content Patcher。[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI 支持的桌面版 Stardew Valley。本版本在 Windows 上构建并测试。[/*]
[*]单人和主机控制的多人模式经过最充分的测试。在多人游戏中，请仅为主机安装本模组，并将主机的世界状态视为权威。[/*]
[*]绑定输出存储时只需使用普通箱子；它们是游戏内物品，并非额外模组依赖。[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]致谢[/b]
[list]
[*]ConcernedApe，创造了 Stardew Valley 以及这个值得拓展的世界。[/*]
[*]Pathoschild 及所有 SMAPI 贡献者，为代码模组提供了框架、文档和工具。[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 模组维基维护者及更广泛的模组社区，他们共享的技术知识使本项目成为可能。[/*]
[*]所有测试长时间工作会话、报告路径与交互问题，并帮助将反复出现的边界情况转化为更可靠版本的测试者们。[/*]
[/list]
